# SAP Development Specification

**Project:** FI AP Vendor Ageing

## 1. Requirement

Create a report for AP accountants that lists open vendor items for a company code and key date and groups the amounts per vendor into ageing buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, >90 days past net due date).

## 2. Development Object

- Report
- ABAP Class

## 3. Business Objective

Month-end review of overdue payables per vendor.

- **Users / Role**: AP accountants (FI-AP)

## 4. Existing Objects (reuse)

| Type | Name | Purpose | What is used |
|---|---|---|---|
| Table | BSIK | Vendor open items (compatibility view in S/4HANA) | BUKRS, LIFNR, BELNR, GJAHR, BUZEI, BUDAT, ZFBDT, ZBD1T, DMBTR, SHKZG |
| Table | LFA1 | Vendor master (name) | LIFNR, NAME1 |

## 5. New Objects

| Type | Proposed name | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Report | ZFI_AP_AGEING | Main report |
| Class | ZCL_FI_AP_AGEING | Ageing calculation |
| Structure | ZFI_S_AP_AGEING | Ageing result line |
| Table Type | ZFI_TT_AP_AGEING | Result table |

## 6. Dependencies

```text
Report + ABAP Class
├── Table BSIK [existing – reuse]
├── Table LFA1 [existing – reuse]
├── Report ZFI_AP_AGEING [new]
├── Class ZCL_FI_AP_AGEING [new]
├── Structure ZFI_S_AP_AGEING [new]
└── Table Type ZFI_TT_AP_AGEING [new]
```

## 7. Technical Design

### Report ZFI_AP_AGEING (new · SE38)

_Main report_

- **Program type**: Executable program (type 1)
- **Transaction code (SE93)** ZFI_AGEING

**Selection screen**

| Name | Statement | FOR / TYPE | Selection text | Mand. | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S_BUKRS | SELECT-OPTIONS | BSIK-BUKRS | Company code | X |  |
| S_LIFNR | SELECT-OPTIONS | BSIK-LIFNR | Vendor |  |  |
| P_KEYDT | PARAMETERS | SY-DATUM | Key date | X | SY-DATUM |

- **Processing logic**:
  1. AUTHORITY-CHECK F_BKPF_BUK per company code
  2. Call ZCL_FI_AP_AGEING=>GET_AGEING
  3. Display ALV
- **Output**: ALV (CL_SALV_TABLE)

**Output columns**

| Field | Column header | Source | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|
| LIFNR | Vendor | BSIK-LIFNR | key, hotspot → FK03 |
| NAME1 | Name | LFA1-NAME1 |  |
| BUCKET_030 | 0-30 days | calculated | sum |
| BUCKET_060 | 31-60 days | calculated | sum |
| BUCKET_090 | 61-90 days | calculated | sum |
| BUCKET_999 | > 90 days | calculated | sum |

### Class ZCL_FI_AP_AGEING (new · SE24 / ADT)

_Ageing calculation_

- **Description**: Reads open items and calculates ageing buckets
- **Class properties**: FINAL

#### Method 1: GET_AGEING

- **Purpose**: Return ageing lines per vendor
- **Visibility**: PUBLIC
- **Level**: Static method (CLASS-METHODS)
- **Kind**: Functional (RETURNING)

**Signature**

| Kind | Parameter | Typing | Type (DE / structure / table type) | VALUE( ) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IMPORTING | IT_BUKRS_RANGE | TYPE RANGE OF | BUKRS |  |
| IMPORTING | IV_KEY_DATE | TYPE | DATS |  |
| RETURNING | RT_AGEING | TYPE | ZFI_TT_AP_AGEING | X |

**Exceptions (RAISING / EXCEPTIONS)**

| Exception | Kind | Raised when |
|---|---|---|
| ZCX_FI_AP_AGEING | Class-based (RAISING) | No company code authorized |

- **Processing logic**:
  1. SELECT open items from BSIK for the company codes
  2. Net due date = ZFBDT + ZBD1T
  3. Days overdue = key date − net due date → bucket
  4. Aggregate per vendor

### Structure ZFI_S_AP_AGEING (new · SE11)

_Ageing result line_

- **Short description**: Vendor ageing line

**Components**

| Field | Data element | Short description | Curr/Qty ref. |
|---|---|---|---|
| BUKRS | BUKRS | Company code |  |
| LIFNR | LIFNR | Vendor |  |
| WAERS | WAERS | Currency |  |
| BUCKET_030 | DMBTR | 0-30 days | WAERS |
| BUCKET_999 | DMBTR | > 90 days | WAERS |

### Table Type ZFI_TT_AP_AGEING (new · SE11)

_Result table_

- **Line type**: ZFI_S_AP_AGEING
- **Access mode**: Standard table
- **Primary key**: Standard key

## 8. Business Rules

| ID | Condition | Expected behavior |
|---|---|---|
| BR-1 | Item is a debit (SHKZG = S) such as a down payment | Include with negative sign |
| BR-2 | Net due date is after the key date | Put the item in the 0-30 bucket |

## 9. Output

- **Expected output**: ALV per vendor with one amount column per ageing bucket in company code currency.

## 10. Authorization

- **Authorization check required?** Yes

**Authority checks**

| Authorization object | Fields = values | Where checked |
|---|---|---|
| F_BKPF_BUK | BUKRS = company code, ACTVT = 03 | AT SELECTION-SCREEN |

## 11. Performance

- **Expected data volume**: Large
- **Performance requirement**: < 60 s for one company code

## 12. Testing

- **Testing required**: ABAP Unit / unit test, Functional test

| ID | Scenario | Expected result |
|---|---|---|
| TC-1 | Company code with overdue items | amounts per bucket |
| TC-2 | Vendor without open items | not listed |
| TC-3 | Company code without authorization | message, no data |

**AC-1**
- **When** the user enters company code 1000 and a key date
- **Then** the report lists one line per vendor with the open amount split into the four buckets

- **Reuse standard SAP (released APIs / CDS / BAPIs) where available?** Yes
- Prefer released SAP APIs, CDS views and extension points.

- **Processing type**: Remote-enabled module

Title:
Customer interaction log

Module:
CRM

Business requirement:
Contact centre agents need to log every customer interaction (channel, topic, outcome) against the business partner and see the interaction history, so supervisors can report first-contact resolution.

Functional requirements:
- FR-01 Log interaction: Channel, topic, outcome and notes per business partner. | acceptance: When an interaction is saved, it appears in the customer's history
- FR-02 Interaction history | acceptance: When the agent opens a customer, the last 20 interactions are shown

TO-BE process:
- Identify the customer (Agent)
- Log interaction (Agent) [Interaction log app]
- Report first-contact resolution (Supervisor)

Interfaces:
- Business partner lookup (outbound) with S/4HANA

Data privacy:
Notes may contain personal data – retention 2 years
